description: Mayer linked-cluster decomposition of light-nuclei binding. b2 identified from the deuteron (unique 2-body nucleus); residual b3, b4 forced by A=3,4 data. Large b3/b2=0.64, b4/b2=4.16 => binding is irreducibly cooperative; no pairwise interface factor can close it.

data.scope_note: does NOT rule out the interface program: the trace product 1-PROD f already carries cross-bond cooperative terms, and the per-bond factors are Lean-proved exact (a permanent correct contribution). Measures the size of the missing cluster operator.
